description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an interface for a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with locking mechanisms, data reading/writing, and buffer management functionalities. The class is designed for inter-process data sharing and includes methods for locking, unlocking, peeking, reading, writing, reserving space, and buffer validation. It also defines an internal Cursor class for data access operations.
